subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is a young male monkey with a thunder-god beak, solitary cheekbones, fiery golden eyes, a pointed mouth and shrunken cheeks, an ugly frame yet agile in movement, like a macaque that feeds on pine cones. His gaze is bright and piercing, his whole body covered in golden hair that is translucent and bright, his limbs long, slender and powerful, leaping and jumping as if flying, born with a lively, unrestrained monkey-king air. His whole body is covered in golden monkey fur, his facial hair is thick, with no deliberate hairstyle, naturally fluffy and messy, the hair on top of his head slightly standing up, showing a wild and untamed temperament. Newly born he was naked, later in the Southern Continent of Jambudvipa he stripped people's clothes and learned to dress like a human; after landing he swaggered through prefectures and passed through counties, his clothing simple and plain, unkempt. His face is smooth and clean, without any beard or mustache, shown in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is a group of monkeys of different sizes and varying fur colors, including golden yellow, grayish brown, white and other shades. Some are old and mature, some young and lively, dragging their males and leading their females in flocks and herds, scratching ears and cheeks, leaping among trees and climbing branches, mischievous and active. Their various monkey furs grow naturally, with no fixed hairstyle, fluffy and messy, flying naturally in the mountain wind. They wear no clothing, their whole bodies covered in natural fur, with fur colors of different monkey species varying in depth, natural and plain, shown in <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is a vast Chinese mythical immortal cave dwelling, ancient and elegant, with an ethereal celestial atmosphere, warm golden tones, soft ambient lighting with a gentle glow; at its center stands a stone stele inscribed with Chinese characters, surrounded by natural stone furniture — stone table, stone chairs, stone bed, stone basin, stone bowls — arranged as a harmonious household; a stone arch bridge leads over a dry rocky stream bed toward the center; lush green moss covers the cave walls, blue-tinged clouds and mist drift near the ceiling, warm light rays filter through narrow crevices in the rock walls; ornamental bamboo, plum blossoms and ancient pine trees grow naturally in the corners, and the distant background shows hanging stalactites and glowing drapery-like mineral formations, with small window-like openings revealing a misty sky, shown in <Picture 3>.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> rising from beside a stone stool inside the cave of <Subject 3> and reciting a promise to the assembled <Subject 2>, then pacing along the stone platform to point out the stone furniture one by one, finally turning back to the camera with both arms spread wide to present the cave as a blessed home. <Subject 1> speaks both lines; <Subject 2> crouches at the left foreground, then rises and gathers at the left side of the platform, watching him throughout.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the young monkey with the thunder-god beak, fiery golden eyes, pointed mouth and shrunken cheeks, bright piercing gaze and golden translucent fur, his head hair slightly standing up, his face smooth and without any beard, is retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the flock of monkeys of different sizes and varying golden yellow, grayish brown and white fur, some old and some young, their natural fur fluffy and loose, are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): weak_reference - style, color palette, lighting mood and stone-and-moss material texture of the immortal cave are guided by the reference, while the actual background adapts to the shot's narrative.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic Chinese xianxia fantasy style with an ethereal atmosphere, warm golden light and ancient stone textures, the palette dominated by amber, moss green and soft blue mist.
[Shot 1] A medium shot, framed from a front eye-level position set slightly low at the center before the stone arch bridge, looks up at <Subject 1> (S1), the young monkey with the thunder-god beak, fiery golden eyes, pointed mouth and shrunken cheeks and golden translucent fur, his head hair slightly standing up and his face smooth and without any beard, as he slowly rises from beside a stone stool in the middle of the frame, his back straight, his gaze sharp as a sword, facing toward the camera. His right index finger points up at the sky, and his golden fur catches the faint cave light like a coat of golden armor. In the left foreground, seen from behind and facing away from the camera, <Subject 2> crouches at one side of the stone bridge, bodies tilted slightly forward, heads lifted toward him, and the camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude as he says in a low, deliberate voice, <d>[Chinese] 你们才说有本事进得来出得去不伤身体者，就拜他为王。</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a medium tracking shot from a side angle 45 degrees to the left at eye level, moving slowly toward screen-right along the stone platform with <Subject 1> as he turns from facing toward the camera to facing toward screen-right, then paces from the center of the platform toward the right side of the frame. In the left background, <Subject 2> stays crouched in place, turning their heads to follow him, facing toward screen-right and gazing upward. Walking on, he lifts a hand and points out the stone table, the stone chairs and the stone bed one by one, and his tone shifts, saying with rising force, <d>[Chinese] 我如今进来又出去，出去又进来，寻了这一个洞天与列位安眠稳睡各享成家之福。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a front eye-level medium shot centered on the frame, the camera drawn slightly back behind the stone bridge so that <Subject 1> (S1) and the cave's stone furniture are both fully in view. He turns from facing toward screen-right back to facing toward the camera, spreads both hands wide to display the stone furnishings and the blessed ground around him, his voice still ardent, and holds the pose with his arms open as the shot ends at 00:15.000. At the left of the frame in medium shot, <Subject 2> has risen and gathered on the left side of the stone platform, facing toward screen-right, watching his open arms and the cave around them.

overall_soundscape:
A deep cave room tone with a faint dripping echo and soft drifting air continues throughout; each of <Subject 1>'s steps on the stone platform lands as a steady, weighty footfall that stacks into layered echoes through the cavern; light rustling of fur and small clawed feet and a few soft non-verbal monkey breaths come from <Subject 2> as they shift and gather.

non_diegetic_music:
A low bamboo flute and a single deep drum, moderate tempo, with the drum entering on a slow regular pulse beneath sustained flute tones, the dynamics building gradually across the three shots to a fuller, broader texture at the final spread-armed pose.
